title: Future Juice Raspberry Filled  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Raspberry Filled Doughnut delivers the comforting taste of a golden, sugar-dusted Doughnut bursting with sweet Raspberry filling. The Doughnut base offers a rich, buttery warmth with a light dusting of sugar, while the Raspberry centre adds a vibrant burst of tangy-sweet fruitiness. The combination creates a perfectly balanced vape that blends indulgence with a touch of sticky sweetness. Your coffee break will never be the same with this fabulous flavour to hand! Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and bold, full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a smooth and satisfying all-day vape. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
